europe_now.title: Russian cargo ship attacked in the Gulf of Finland
europe_now.summary: A Russia-bound vessel sustained damage after being struck by a drone in the Gulf of Finland. Both Finnish and Russian authorities acknowledged the incident involving the damaged cargo ship.

sources.headline: Russia-bound ship attacked in Gulf of Finland
Drone attack sets Russian cargo ship ablaze in Gulf of Finland

europe_now.title: Denmark expels diplomat following assassination plot accusations
europe_now.summary: Denmark has accused Russia of orchestrating an assassination plot against a US-Ukrainian citizen and subsequently expelled a diplomat. European Union leadership strongly condemned the alleged hostile action.

sources.headline: 'Unacceptable': EU chief condemns alleged Russian plot to kill US-Ukrainian citizen
Denmark accuses Russia of plotting to assassinate US-Ukrainian rapper

top_stories.title: Ongoing Social Unrest and Protests in France
top_stories.summary: Demonstrations across France entered their sixth consecutive week with citizens turning out for fresh protests. Official figures and union estimates varied regarding the overall turnout numbers during the ongoing social mobilization.

sources.headline: France: Demonstrations losing steam as movement enters sixth week
New day of protests across France

top_stories.title: EU and UK Finalize Post-Brexit Accord
top_stories.summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom successfully reached an agreement to reset relations following Brexit. Officials from both sides concluded the post-Brexit diplomatic arrangement to foster closer cooperation.

sources.headline: EU, UK reach reset deal after Brexit

top_stories.title: EU Budget Proposal Sparks Debate Over Spending Cuts
top_stories.summary: A newly introduced EU budget proposal outlines significant reductions intended to target global technology giants. The proposed financial plan has created divisions among member states ahead of an upcoming summit.
